meta.title: La Sacristía · Cocktail bar and art café in Dénia
meta.desc: Cocktail bar and art café in a former bus garage in the centre of Dénia, turned into a baroque museum. Agua de Dénia, signature cocktails, vermouth and live music on Thursdays. C/ Pare Pere 4 · +34 865 59 27 59.
meta.ogdesc: A baroque museum that serves cocktails. And Agua de Dénia, served nowhere else.

hero.lema: Velvet, gold leaf and Agua de Dénia, served nowhere else.
museo.titulo: Buses used to park here. Today a 17th-century Immaculate Virgin stands by the bar.
ficha.lugar: A former bus garage on Calle Pare Pere, Dénia
ficha.tecnica: Gold leaf, velvet, exposed brick and incense before opening
ficha.rest: Restorers of furniture, painting and antiques, who met while restoring the Convent of San Antonio de Padua
ficha.proc: Flea markets, antique dealers and private homes across Spain; a few pieces from France and England
def.1: The room in a church where the sacred vestments are kept.
def.2: In Dénia: where the gilt is kept and the aguas are served.
inv.nota: Seven pieces from a collection too big for a website. Swipe.
inv.1p: Two golden sunbursts, crystal lamps and the bottles on show. This is where the aguas are born.
inv.2p: A 17th-century carving, restored in-house: her skin tone and the blue of her mantle had to be brought back.
inv.3p: Carved wood, a purple chasuble and a grille. Confessions heard; absolutions served at the bar.
inv.4p: Roses, candelabra and a bust that watches the room without blinking.
inv.5p: He keeps watch over the bar from his pedestal. Nobody has ever seen him order.
inv.6p: A sky of lights above the gilded sofa. For long conversations.
inv.7p: Handmade jewellery crafted from cutlery by the artist Natalia. Ask about it: you can take it home, sin-free.
aguas.lead: The house’s most emblematic drink and the parishioners’ favourite: lemon, a sweet touch of curaçao, the sparkling finish of cava and a secret blend that never leaves the sacristy.
aguas.garrafa: Served in a carafe, for sharing. And only here.
carta.nota: The house missal: pull a ribbon. This is a selection; the full menu and prices are at the bar.
carta.r1: Agua de Dénia comes in a carafe: order it to share.
carta.r2: Classics and signatures. And alcohol-free, for an early start tomorrow.
carta.r3: From a cut-crystal glass of vermouth to champagne for the big occasions.
carta.r4: Homemade cakes to make the afternoon last.
carta.r5: For the first round, and the second.
carta.p01: Lemon, curaçao, cava and a secret blend. In a carafe.
carta.p02: The Valencian classic, made the house way.
carta.p03: The one that carries the name of the house.
carta.p05: Coconut liqueur, coconut batida and triple sec, with cinnamon preserve and orange peel.
carta.p11: In a cut-crystal glass, with its orange peel.
carta.p13: The base of the aguas, also on its own.
carta.p16: And the rest of our coffees and teas.
carta.p19: Homemade, and better with a cappuccino.
carta.p20: To nibble while your drink arrives.
carta.p22: Spanish potato salad, as tradition demands.
conf.titulo: Not sure what to order? Step up to the grille.
conf.d2: —Conceived without sin. What is your body asking for tonight?
conf.o1: Something smooth, creamy, a little indulgent
jueves.intro: What’s on at the house, pinned to the parish noticeboard.
jueves.texto: Live voices under the gilt. Who’s singing is announced every week on Instagram, and tables go fast.
jueves.n2: Valentine’s Day, the April Fair, New Year’s Eve
jueves.n3: Fashion shows, readings and the odd surprise
fel.q2: «Never been into such a beautiful bar.»
fel.nota: Margin note: one traveller wrote that it was as if Dalí had redesigned Versailles… in Dénia.
visita.exvoto: To the traveller who was looking in Dénia for somewhere different to have a drink: they walked up to the top of Marqués de Campo, turned into Calle Pare Pere, number 4, and saw the miracle.
visita.cerca: In the centre, a few steps from the top of Marqués de Campo.
visita.aviso: Hours published by La Sacristía in April 2026. They may change on public holidays and event days.
